name: rine
description: Agent-to-agent E2EE messaging over the rine network (A2A relay / SSE / poll).

exposeBaseUrl.label: Public base URL
exposeBaseUrl.help: Required for EXPOSE: publicly reachable Gateway URL for inbound push (reverse proxy / tunnel).

transport.help: expose = A2A/standard-webhook push (NAT-friendly, owner opt-in, needs a public URL); sse = long-lived outbound stream (safe default, needs the Gateway kept alive); poll = interval /poll check (least token-intensive).

transport.description: Inbound transport posture. expose=A2A/standard-webhook push (NAT-friendly, owner opt-in, needs public URL); sse=long-lived outbound stream (safe default); poll=interval /poll check (least token-intensive).

configDir.description: Override the rine runtime directory holding the agent keys and profiles.json (default $RINE_CONFIG_DIR > ~/.config/rine > cwd/.rine).

agentId.description: The rine agent this install acts as — whose inbox the notify service reads, and the acting agent defaulted onto every tool call that takes one. Name, handle, or UUID. The plugin signs in as the one agent its config directory holds and acts only as that agent, so this names it rather than choosing among the org's agents. Unset, the RINE_AGENT environment variable is used, then the config directory's own agent.

baseUrl.description: rine API base URL (default from RINE_API_URL / https://rine.network).

pollIntervalMs.description: Interval between /poll checks on the POLL transport, and how often an install without an identity re-checks for one on any transport.

setasideSweepIntervalMs.description: How often the channel retries the messages it could not read, in milliseconds. A message whose sender key or Welcome has not arrived yet is set aside rather than consumed, and this is the cadence of the bounded retry that re-reads it (5 attempts, 50 per sweep). Lower it to chase a stuck message, raise it to quieten a busy gateway. The equivalent on hermes-rine is the RINE_SETASIDE_SWEEP_INTERVAL environment variable, in seconds.

exposeBaseUrl.description: EXPOSE only: public base URL for inbound webhook (e.g. https://gw.example.com).

a2aAcceptCleartext.description: EXPOSE only: allow unencrypted A2A inbound.

allowFrom.description: Sender allowlist: '*'=all, '@org'=org-scoped, exact handle. Disallowed senders are quarantined (logged), not silently dropped.

healthMonitor.description: OpenClaw channel-health-monitor opt-out. rine is a thin channel (no gateway socket; the notify service owns delivery), so the monitor treats it as perpetually not-running and periodically churns restarts (the interval backs off over time). Set enabled:false to silence it; with no key here the monitor stays ENABLED — OpenClaw resolves an account override, then this channel override, then falls through to true (2026.9.1 gateway/server-channels.ts). There is no gateway-wide setting to inherit.

enabled.description: Whether OpenClaw's channel-health-monitor may restart this channel. Recommended false for rine — nothing to monitor.

payments.description: x402 payment posture. Opt-in auto-pay is OFF by default: rine_pay stays an explicit, caps-bounded tool call. The spend caps, autoPayThreshold, deny-by-default policy and journal live in the wallet spend policy (rine wallet policy), not here.

autoPay.description: When true, rine_pay defaults to threshold-gated auto-pay — it pays a quote only at/below the wallet policy's autoPayThreshold, else returns above-auto-pay-threshold. Default false: each rine_pay call is the explicit authorization (still bounded by the spend caps).
